messages:
mia: quick prototype posted: inline badge hint when a version is pinned. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/newproto
trent: big Q: badges show catalog metrics or pinned metrics by default when pinned?
anne: prefer catalog-by-default with a subtle inline hint for pinned rows. keeps context consistent for most users.
kerry_a11y: accessibility: hint must be keyboard-focusable, have aria-label like 'Show pinned metrics for Model A (v1.2) - 120 ms', and visible focus ring. badge text needs 4.5:1 contrast; use darker text on yellow.
trent: impl note: per-row popovers hurt virtualization. suggest session-level override stored in route state and a tiny inline button that toggles it. popover should be a portal.
mia: proposed flow: 1) default to catalog metrics. 2) when user pins single row, show inline hint 'Pinned active — View pinned metrics'. 3) if accepted, persist for session only. 4) multi-select pins open dense compare modal that always shows pinned metrics per-row.
frontend-bot: ci: visual snapshot for branch badge-hint -> https://ci.internal/snap/3050 (diffs: focus ring, badge color)
trent: telemetry request: add events hint_shown/hint_accepted/toggle_changed to measure adoption.
kerry_a11y: +1 with aria-live polite on metric updates and role=menu for popover items.
mia: thanks all  i'll update figma and add a short PR checklist in this thread. thumbs?
trent: :+1:
anne: :+1:
kerry_a11y: :+1: with notes above
